posts.author: xclnth
posts.body:
was reading the help file--
If the failure message is “...dodged the attack”, the skill is considered a physical skill and uses the “Normal attack accuracy” formula.
How do you get a skill to be considered a physical skill?
I'm trying to make it where agility affects the skill accuracy--  is that possible?

posts.author: Cherry
posts.body:
Unfortunately there is no way to do that in RPG Maker 2003
, the corresponding setting has been removed because the "failure message" was part of the RPG Maker 2000 battle system. (Yes, that's a bug and also an oversight in the help file.)
EDIT:
Now there is a way
.

posts.author: xclnth
posts.body: Ah!  Thank you for clearing this up for me.  I was BUGGED myself, ok I'll stop.

posts.author: Cherry
posts.body:
Now it BUGGED (^^) me enough that I decided to do something about it.
Behold my new tool, the
RM2k3 Physical Skill Converter
!
Download:
https://cherryshare.at/f/a1ueIH/physical_skill_converter.exe
1. Copy the skill from the RM2k3 database
2. Run this tool
3. You can see whether the skill is physical. To change it, select YES (convert to physical) or NO (convert to non-physical), or select CANCEL to not change it at all.
4. If you changed it: Paste the skill back into the RM2k3 database
Note: In some unlikely but remotely possible corner cases, the tool might incorrectly show a skill as physical when it's not. That's why you can always choose to convert.
